facts.fact: Bank of Zambia figures from the 2025 FinScope survey show mobile money usage at 76.2% in Zambia, and financial inclusion at 80.1% up from 69.4% in 2020.
Bank of Zambia figures from the 2025 FinScope survey show mobile money usage at 76.2% in Zambia, and financial inclusion at 80.1% up from 69.4% in 2020.

note: The 80.1% is financial inclusion, not stated as an account share, so no fact for the four-in-five rung.
